about: The rules of the res/graph store that need no stored state. Every implementation applies them before it writes anything.

applies_to: schema relationship types and endpoint kinds
names.qualified: A kind or relationship type is '<namespace>/<name>' with a non-empty name, and the whole value matches the pattern.

secrets.value_prefixes_match: case-insensitively, at the start of the string
value_prefixes_apply_to: string attribute values, at any depth

max_string_bytes_applies_to: string attribute values, at any depth
sizes.record_bytes: The length of the JSON encoding of a record's labels plus that of its attributes.

options.about: The bounds a store is opened with. A value that is absent or not positive takes the default.

max_changes.bounds: retained commits in the change history

max_change_bytes.bounds: the summed size of retained commits; a commit's size is the length of its canonical JSON (README.md, Canonical JSON). The latest commit is always retained.

max_transaction_records.bounds: vertices + edges + delete_vertices + delete_edges in one transaction

max_record_bytes.bounds: record_bytes of one vertex or edge

max_results.bounds: the limit of query_vertices, query_edges and changes, the buffer of watch and the max_vertices of traverse

order: context: a canceled or expired context fails first (canceled, timeout)
the rules in this file (invalid, denied, too_large)
the idempotency key: a stored key with the same fingerprint replays its commit, with a different one fails (exists)
delete_edges, then delete_vertices, then vertices, then edges, against the committed state plus the earlier parts of the transaction (not_found, invalid)
the namespace schema, over the vertices and edges the transaction writes (invalid)

codes.about: The codes a store returns, from res/system/testdata/codes.json. Error text is not part of the contract.
codes.invalid: a malformed name, record or transaction; a limit that is not positive; a schema rule the transaction breaks; deleting a vertex that still has incident edges without delete_incident_edges
codes.not_found: a record that does not exist; an unregistered namespace; an edge endpoint that does not exist
codes.changed: expected_revision is not the namespace's current revision
codes.exists: an idempotency key reused with a different transaction; a schema registered again at the same version with different rules
codes.too_large: a value, record, transaction, result limit, snapshot or watch backlog beyond its bound
codes.expired: a change cursor older than the history floor
codes.unsupported: a durable store whose layout is not this contract's
codes.busy: another writer held the database past the store's wait
